Synopsis:
India flagged a pattern of fraudulent Facebook/Instagram ads using sexually explicit content to distribute malware targeting banking credentials. Meta removed 39+ active ads after Reuters flagged them — notably after, not before, the government advisory. The article also references internal Meta projections that scam/banned-goods ads could account for ~$16B (~10%) of its 2024 revenue, raising platform accountability concerns. This follows a parallel incident involving Google Firebase being used to impersonate Indian banks.
